title: Real Palindrome
story: Ignore spaces, punctuation and case: is the phrase the same backwards?
goal: Write is_palindrome(s): True when the letters and digits of s read the same both ways, ignoring case and everything else.

tests.label: phrase
tests.expr: is_palindrome("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama")

hints: Build a cleaned string first: only characters where ch.isalnum().
Lowercase it, then compare with its reverse.
socratic: What should be thrown away first?
How do you compare with the reverse?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Real Palindrome”?
